fields.title: Powerlifting
fields.description: A strength-based sport focusing on maximum lifts in squat, bench press, and deadlift.

fields.title: CrossFit
fields.description: A high-intensity fitness program incorporating elements from various sports, including weightlifting, gymnastics, and cardio.

fields.title: Strongman
fields.description: A strength sport featuring events like lifting heavy stones, pulling trucks, and overhead pressing large weights.

fields.title: Bodybuilding
fields.description: A sport focused on developing muscle size and symmetry through resistance training and posing routines.

fields.title: Olympic Weightlifting
fields.description: A strength sport involving two lifts: the snatch and the clean and jerk, focusing on power, speed, and technique.

fields.title: Functional Training
fields.description: A fitness regimen designed to improve overall strength, balance, and flexibility through compound movements.

fields.title: Kettlebell Training
fields.description: A dynamic training method using kettlebells for exercises like swings, cleans, and snatches to build strength and endurance.

fields.title: HIIT
fields.description: High-Intensity Interval Training, focusing on short bursts of intense exercise followed by recovery periods.

fields.title: Calisthenics
fields.description: A form of bodyweight training focused on exercises like pull-ups, push-ups, and dips to build strength and control.

fields.title: Pilates
fields.description: A low-impact exercise method that aims to improve core strength, flexibility, and posture through controlled movements.
